[USER] It is decided to simultaneously pump water into the half-full tank while draining it.  
[USER] What is the rate at which water has to be pumped in so that it gets fully filled in 10 minutes?  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To fill a half-full tank in 10 minutes while also draining it at a constant rate, the rate at which water is pumped in must be twice the rate at which it is drained.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The rate at which it is drained is 1/30 of the tank's capacity per minute.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Therefore, the rate at which water must be pumped in is 2 * (1/30) of the tank's capacity per minute, or 2/30 of the tank's capacity per minute.
